finding: We tested whether partial disclosure of the source prior improves retained coverage. It improves expected retained mass in 348 of 1,260 distinct partial-disclosure problems, capturing the full-disclosure benefit in 342. This is a constructed-method result about gross information value in a finite storage library; it does not establish forecast accuracy or process correspondence.
